definitions.explanation: A political or social system in which obedience to authority is enforced at the expense of personal freedom. Also used more broadly to describe a mindset that values authority and hierarchy above individual autonomy.

examples.japanese: {権威主義|けんいしゅぎ}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{権威主義|けんいしゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Voices opposing authoritarianism are growing louder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{権威主義|けんいしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The confrontation between democracy and authoritarianism has become a global issue.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{権威|けんい}→権威：13173_keni⟧ (authority) + ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism). Refers to political systems or attitudes that prioritize obedience to authority over individual freedom.

FORMS:
- {権威主義的|けんいしゅぎてき} (na-adjective): authoritarian
- {権威主義者|けんいしゅぎしゃ}: authoritarian (person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {権威主義|けんいしゅぎ}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: authoritarian regime
- {権威主義|けんいしゅぎ}⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧: authoritarian state
- {権威主義|けんいしゅぎ}⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧: authoritarian government

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧: democracy
- {自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}: liberalism
- {全体主義|ぜんたいしゅぎ}: totalitarianism (more extreme)

Frequently appears in news, political analysis, and academic writing.
